adversarialCases.scenario: Backend returns HTTP 200 but missing required status/run/timestamp fields.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Gate requires explicit stale/error/unavailable DOM state and blocks live success.

adversarialCases.scenario: Reference/demo fixture data appears as live evidence.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Must be labeled reference/demo and cannot satisfy live data provenance.

adversarialCases.scenario: A chart is visible but has no tooltip/crosshair/focus/click evidence.
Process page uses fixed poster nodes, canned logs, or invented workers.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Process reality scores zero or page must show explicit reference/unavailable state.

adversarialCases.scenario: Load sends mutating POST/export/record_decision, opens /sim/ws, emits outbound WS control, or writes protected storage.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Completion blocks; network/write trace must prove absence.

adversarialCases.scenario: V3 becomes default before deterministic 100/100 and V2 parity-plus-improvement evidence.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: V2 remains default and V3 stays explicit/selectable.
